description: This file defines a custom exception class `EmailConfigurationSMTPUsernameNotValid` which extends a platform-specific domain rule exception, used to indicate that an SMTP username for email configuration is invalid.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationSMTPUsernameNotValid
classes.description: Custom exception indicating an invalid SMTP username in email configuration.

methods.name: EmailConfigurationSMTPUsernameNotValid
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specific SMTP username, generating a message that indicates the username is not valid.
